title: Detached release-status head checkpoint authentication evidence

checkpointDigest.description: Canonical SHA-256 digest of the complete release-status-head checkpoint.

requestNonce.description: Must exactly equal the nonce bound inside the checkpoint and supplied by the caller.

authorityBindingDigest.description: Exact digest of the complete permitted signer identity bound to the checkpoint trust-policy reference and signing repository.

signingResult.description: Complete purpose-, repository-, subject-, key-, identity-, and trust-policy-bound signing result. Its subjectDigest must equal checkpointDigest.

evidenceDigest.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 JCS bytes for the exact bytedesk.release-status-head-authentication-evidence-digest/1 preimage declared by x-bytedesk-digestAuthority. evidenceDigest itself, contract, and schema are excluded from that preimage.

description: Detached authentication avoids a checkpoint/signature content cycle. Offline verification recomputes the evidence digest, verifies the complete signing result against the exact status-head trust policy, and requires its purpose, subject digest, media type, nonce, and authority identity to match the checkpoint.
